attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Calder Combine reports good harvests along the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as if it were a fresh item, though the facts are unchanged"},{"span":"They are apparently happy about the yield.","severity":"minor","reason":"implied status of the Combine's mood, which the briefing does not give"},{"span":"I suspect this is just another Tuesday for them.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies robbery is routine, but it is framed as a guess, so only a very weak concern"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin is padded well past a quiet week's 40 to 80 words, with three items and no real dry wit. It also gives a full item to old news (the Combine harvest), and the first item is a bare restatement with no take."}
